description: Timed on-chain Snake with provably fair food placement. Pick a bounty trail, pay a small GAS entry, and reach the route target before the deadline to win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Garden Trail (10), 0.5 for Market Trail (20), 1 for Apex Trail (35). Swipe or use WASD/arrow keys to steer the snake — wall or self collision ends the run. No undos: every move is final. Winnings accrue as withdrawable credit and every solve is ranked on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 限时链上贪吃蛇，食物位置可验证公平。选择赏金蛇道并支付少量 GAS 报名费，在截止时间内达到路线目标长度即可赢取固定 GAS 奖励：花园蛇道 0.1（10 节）、集市蛇道 0.5（20 节）、巅峰蛇道 1（35 节）。滑动或使用 WASD/方向键控制蛇的移动——撞墙或撞自身即告失败。落子即锁定，无撤回功能。奖金以可提取余额累计，每次通关都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。
name: Snake Bounty

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: Game seeds come from a fixed block-beacon commit/reveal: the seed hashes the first block after the start transaction with the player and game id, so neither side can pick a starting state. Seed grinding cannot mint rewards here — any seed still yields a game that must be played within the same limits. Morpheus VRF + TEE game sealing is the planned upgrade path for server-private deals.

tee.description: The play session is verified by Morpheus TEE compute before settlement, with the contract bound to the configured Morpheus oracle kernel on testnet.
